azure.referenceText: For centuries, mapmakers have faced an unavoidable problem: representing a curved planet on a flat surface. Every projection distorts something, whether it is the size of continents, the shape of coastlines, or the distances between cities. The familiar Mercator map, originally designed for navigation, preserves angles but dramatically exaggerates regions near the poles.
